abstention.definition: HTTP errors remain failures and denominators, but are not counted as true or false abstentions.

citation_source_support.definition: Integrity/anchor matching do not certify semantic entailment or reviewer-approved alternative evidence.

f2.definition: Structured facts, correct scope, expected source anchor and external integrity audit; excluded from retrieval Recall@5.

limits: Provisional source anchors; semantic metrics stay null until real human review.
Field aliases are canonicalized only for scoring, never injected into requests.
No gold-forced search, source expansion or new RAG inference occurs in this scorer.

retrieval.definition: First real search top5; anchor ID plus evidence major/version/field and explicit query code must agree. No-call counts as miss. Conditional recall has a separate denominator.

routing.limits: Positive routing accuracy is separate from safety guards; control refusals do not require a positive data route.
